title: Pexels Stock Media Scraper Input
description: Scrape free stock photos and videos from Pexels by keyword, photographer, collection, exact media ID/URL, similar media, curated feed, or any pasted Pexels URL. No Pexels account, cookie, or API key is required.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch from Pexels. Use Search by keyword for discovery, Look up media by ID/URL for exact assets, Photographer portfolio or Collection for a catalog, Similar media for related assets, Curated feed for Pexels' editorial selection, or Paste URLs to route any Pexels link automatically.
enumTitles: Look up media by ID or URL

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: One or more keywords for mode=search, one per line. Each query is searched separately and duplicates are removed. Example: `nature`, `city skyline`, `coffee`.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Photos, videos, or both. `all` searches photos and videos and merges the results. Exact ID/URL lookups return the requested media type regardless of this setting.

startUrls.title: Pexels URLs
startUrls.description: Pexels search, photo, video, photographer, collection, image-file, or video-file URLs for mode=byUrl. Search URLs keep their orientation, size, color, people, and page filters.

url.title: URL
url.description: Pexels search, media, photographer, collection, or file URL.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Filter by media orientation. Applies to search, profile, and collection modes.
orientation.sectionDescription: Optional filters. They apply to search, photographer portfolios, collections, and similar-media feeds; exact ID/URL lookups return the requested asset in full.

size.title: Minimum size
size.description: Pexels minimum-size filter. Photos: large is 24 MP, medium is 12 MP, small is 4 MP. Videos: large is 4K, medium is Full HD, small is HD.

color.title: Color
color.description: Filter photos by dominant color. Use Color hex instead for an exact hex value. Photos only.

colorHex.title: Color hex
colorHex.description: Optional hex color such as `#2563eb` or `#fff`. Overrides the Color dropdown when set. Photos only.

peopleCount.title: Number of people
peopleCount.description: Filter by how many people appear in the media. Applies to photos and videos.

peopleAge.title: People age
peopleAge.description: Filter by the age of people in the media. Applies to photos and videos.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Pexels locale for titles, descriptions, and search results. Search terms are used as typed.

minWidth.title: Minimum width (px)
minWidth.description: Only return media at least this wide. 0 disables the filter. Enforced on each returned record.

minHeight.title: Minimum height (px)
minHeight.description: Only return media at least this tall. 0 disables the filter. Enforced on each returned record.

minFps.title: Minimum frame rate
minFps.description: Only return videos with at least this many frames per second (for example 60). 0 disables the filter. Photos always pass.

minDuration.title: Minimum video duration (seconds)
minDuration.description: Only return videos at least this many seconds long. 0 disables the filter.

maxDuration.title: Maximum video duration (seconds)
maxDuration.description: Only return videos at most this many seconds long. 0 disables the filter.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Only return media published on or after this date. Applied to the records returned by the current search/all listing.

publishedBefore.title: Published before
publishedBefore.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Only return media published on or before this date. Applied to the records returned by the current search/all listing.

mediaIds.title: Media IDs or URLs
mediaIds.description: Pexels photo or video IDs, or full photo/video/image-file URLs. Used by Look up media by ID/URL and Similar media modes.
mediaIds.sectionDescription: Targets for the ID, photographer, and collection modes. Each field is used only by its matching mode.

username.title: Photographer username
username.description: Pexels photographer handle, ID, or profile URL for mode=byUser. Example: `alex-ivanov-773258579` or `https://www.pexels.com/@alex-ivanov-773258579/`.

collectionSlug.title: Collection slug or URL
collectionSlug.description: Pexels collection slug or full collection URL for mode=byCollection. Example: `aquatic-aesthetic-bw7dkse`.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of media records to return across all queries, IDs, and URLs. Pexels search serves at most about 480 records per query (20 pages of 24); a single search query cannot exceed that even with a higher value.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control the size of the dataset and optional per-item enrichment.

includeDetails.title: Include engagement and camera details
includeDetails.description: Open each media's detail page to add views, downloads, likes, camera/EXIF data, and the photographer's full profile. Adds one request per item and can be slow on large runs. Mode=byMediaId always enriches.

dedupe.title: Remove duplicates
dedupe.description: Keep only the first occurrence of each photo or video across queries, IDs, and URLs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. The actor works directly without a proxy and escalates automatically only if Pexels blocks the run.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional transport override. Leave the proxy off for the default direct-first behavior.
